question: In Africa, which countries have the most cities with more than one million inhabitants? For the ten countries with the highest number, tell me how many such cities each has and how many people live in those cities altogether.
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS million_plus_cities, SUM(p.pop_max) AS combined_city_population FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.continent = 'Africa' AND p.pop_max > 1000000 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY million_plus_cities DESC, combined_city_population DESC, c.name LIMIT 10

question: Looking at European countries, which ones pack the most large cities — half a million people or more — relative to their size? I'd like the number of such cities per 100,000 square kilometres of the country's area, but only for countries that have at least three of them, ranked from the highest density down.
sql: WITH areas AS (SELECT name, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2 FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Europe'), big_city_counts AS (SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS big_cities FROM countries c JOIN populated_places p ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.continent = 'Europe' AND p.pop_max >= 500000 GROUP BY c.name) SELECT a.name AS country, b.big_cities, ROUND(b.big_cities * 100000.0 / a.area_km2, 2) AS big_cities_per_100k_km2 FROM areas a JOIN big_city_counts b ON b.name = a.name WHERE b.big_cities >= 3 ORDER BY big_cities_per_100k_km2 DESC, a.name

question: I'm drawing a world map by hand. For each continent, how many capital cities does the data contain, and can you give me — as GeoJSON — the smallest rectangle that encloses all the capitals on that continent?
sql: SELECT c.continent, COUNT(*) AS capital_count, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(p.geometry)) AS capitals_bounding_box_geojson FROM populated_places p JOIN countries c ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE p.is_capital GROUP BY c.continent ORDER BY c.continent

question: Starting from the spot at longitude 74.5417 and latitude 41.4622 in Kyrgyzstan, which countries have at least one city of a million or more people within 2,000 kilometres of that spot? For each country, count those cities and add up their populations, showing the countries with the largest combined population first.
sql: SELECT p.country, COUNT(*) AS million_cities_within_2000_km, SUM(p.pop_max) AS combined_population FROM populated_places p WHERE p.pop_max >= 1000000 AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(p.geometry, ST_Point(74.5417, 41.4622), 2000000) GROUP BY p.country ORDER BY combined_population DESC, p.country

question: Not every point in the dataset is a town — some are scientific research stations. Which countries have one or more of these stations inside their territory? For each country, tell me how many stations it has and list their names in alphabetical order, starting with the country that has the most.
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS station_count, string_agg(p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS station_names FROM populated_places p JOIN countries c ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE p.feature_class = 'Scientific station' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY station_count DESC, c.name

question: For every country in South America, how many other countries does its territory touch, and how many people live in all those neighbouring countries combined? Countries that touch no other country should show zero, and I want the list ordered with the most neighbours at the top.
sql: SELECT a.name AS country, COUNT(b.name) AS neighbouring_countries, COALESCE(SUM(b.pop_est), 0) AS neighbours_combined_population FROM countries a LEFT JOIN countries b ON ST_Intersects(a.geometry, b.geometry) AND a.name <> b.name WHERE a.continent = 'South America' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY neighbouring_countries DESC, a.name
